# PlayBox Privacy Notice

Effective date: 12 June 2026

This Privacy Notice describes how Infinite Spaces ("Infinite Spaces", "we", "us", or "our") handles personal information in connection with the **PlayBox** mobile application (`org.infinitespaces.playbox`), distributed through Google Play and the Apple App Store (the "App"). It applies to the App only. Other Infinite Spaces products and websites are governed by their own notices.

PlayBox is used to enter and take part in live, in-person experiences at a venue. You can pay by contactless card or present a pass at the entrance, and the App grants your entry or credit for the experience.

## 1. Information We Collect

### Payment and transaction information

When you pay by contactless card, your card is read and processed by our payment processor, Stripe. Your full card number, security code, and expiry are handled by Stripe and are not received or stored by Infinite Spaces. We receive a payment token, a non-identifying card "fingerprint" (a one-way value that lets us recognise a returning card without seeing the card number), the transaction amount, and the resulting credit or entry. Together these form your transaction history.

### Identifiers

When you first use the App, we create an anonymous identifier so that your entry, credit, and any items earned during the experience function correctly. This identifier is not your real-world identity, and you are not required to register or create an account to use the App.

### Account information

The App does not currently require or offer account registration. If we make account creation available in the future and you choose to create an account, we would collect the information you provide for that purpose, such as your name, email address, or phone number. We will update this Notice and our app-store disclosures before collecting such information.

### Usage and quality information

We collect information about how the experience runs — for example participation time, engagement, spend, and streaming performance — to operate, measure, and improve the quality of the service. We do not use this information for advertising and we do not build advertising profiles.

### Device features

The App uses your device's near-field communication (NFC) capability to read contactless payments and runs a temporary foreground service while a payment reader session is active. We do not collect your precise or approximate location, contacts, photos, files, calendar, or microphone audio.

## 2. How We Use Your Information

- To process payments and grant the corresponding credit or entry.
- To operate and deliver the live experience.
- To maintain accurate transaction and accounting records.
- To measure, secure, and improve the quality and reliability of the service, and to detect and prevent fraud and abuse.
- To comply with our legal and regulatory obligations.

## 3. Legal Bases for Processing (EEA and UK)

If you are in the European Economic Area or the United Kingdom, we process your personal information on the following legal bases: performance of a contract (to process your payment and provide entry and access to the experience); our legitimate interests (to secure, measure, and improve the service and to prevent fraud); compliance with a legal obligation (for example, accounting and tax record-keeping); and, where required, your consent.

## 4. How We Share Your Information

We share personal information only with the following categories of recipients:

- **Payment processors** — to process your card payment securely (Stripe).
- **Infrastructure and service providers** — providers that host and operate the service on our behalf under contractual confidentiality and data-protection obligations.
- **Infinite Spaces' own backend services** — to grant entry and credit, associate your transactions with your identifier, and run the experience.

We may also disclose information where required by law, to enforce our terms, or in connection with a corporate transaction. **We do not sell your personal information, we do not "share" it for cross-context behavioral advertising, and we do not display advertising in the App.**

## 5. International Data Transfers

We and our service providers may process personal information in countries other than your own, including the United States. Where we transfer personal information across borders, we rely on appropriate safeguards, such as the European Commission's Standard Contractual Clauses, to protect that information.

## 6. Data Retention

- If you never create an account, your anonymous record is anonymised after a limited period; we retain the identifier and ledger entries as needed for accounting, but remove any contact linkage.
- If you create an account, we retain account information until you ask us to delete it.
- We retain transaction and accounting records for as long as required for tax, accounting, and fraud-prevention purposes.
- Card-data retention is governed by Stripe as the processor that holds it.

## 7. Security

We use technical and organizational measures designed to protect personal information, including encryption of data in transit using TLS (HTTPS). No method of transmission or storage is completely secure, but we work to protect your information and to address incidents appropriately.

## 8. Your Privacy Rights

Depending on where you live, you may have the right to access, correct, delete, or obtain a copy of your personal information; to restrict or object to certain processing; to withdraw consent where processing is based on consent; and to lodge a complaint with your local data-protection authority. You can exercise these rights, including requesting deletion, at [infinitespaces.org/playbox-data-deletion](/playbox-data-deletion) or by emailing [contact@infinitespaces.org](mailto:contact@infinitespaces.org). We will not discriminate against you for exercising your rights.

**California residents.** We do not sell or share your personal information, and we do not use it for cross-context behavioral advertising. You may exercise your rights to know, access, delete, and correct your personal information using the contact details above.

## 9. Children's Privacy

PlayBox is intended for users aged 13 and over and is not directed to children under 13. Account use requires a minimum age of 13, and payment features are limited to adults (18+) or completed with verifiable parental consent. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children under 13 without verifiable parental consent. If we learn we have done so, we will delete it. Parents or guardians may contact us at [contact@infinitespaces.org](mailto:contact@infinitespaces.org).

## 10. Changes to This Notice

We may update this Notice from time to time. When we make material changes, we will update the "Effective date" above and, where appropriate, provide additional notice. The current version is always available at [infinitespaces.org/playbox-privacy](/playbox-privacy).

## 11. Contact Us

For questions about this Notice or to exercise your privacy rights, contact us at [contact@infinitespaces.org](mailto:contact@infinitespaces.org).
